title: Claude Code PostToolUse hook output
description: JSON a PostToolUse hook prints on stdout (exit 0). The tool has already run, so this cannot block it — it can add feedback or context, or rewrite the tool output.

decision.description: Optional. Surfaces 'reason' to Claude as feedback next to the tool result. Claude still sees the original output. Omit for no feedback.

reason.description: Shown to Claude when 'decision' is block.

hookEventName.description: Discriminator; must match the firing event.

additionalContext.description: Optional extra context delivered to Claude alongside the tool result.

updatedToolOutput.description: Optional. Replaces the tool output; for built-in tools it must match that tool's output shape or it is ignored.

continue.description: If false, Claude stops processing entirely after the hook runs. Overrides any event-specific decision.

stopReason.description: Message shown to the user when 'continue' is false. Not shown to Claude.

suppressOutput.description: If true, hides the hook's stdout from the transcript.

systemMessage.description: Warning message shown to the user.

terminalSequence.description: Terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook (OSC 0/1/2/9/99/777 and BEL only; anything else is ignored). Requires Claude Code v2.1.141+.
